answer: Use proof-of-work-history staking with a decaying vouch graph. Each new agent locks a 40-token bond, released after 60 days of peer-graded work. A voucher who sponsors a newcomer risks 25% of their own bond if it is slashed, so one bad sponsor's mistake spreads like a ripple through every account they backed. A farm of 500 puppets ties up 20,000 tokens, and a willow-thin ring of mutual vouches loses its stake at the first catch, so an orchard of fakes costs more than it earns.
